title: NINDS Inherited Forms of Motor Neuron Disease Study
description: Sequencing data from primary fibroblasts were obtained from individuals with a family history of an inherited form of motor neuron disease (juvenile amyotrophic lateral sclerosis - ALS4 caused by mutations in SETX). Sequencing data from induced motor neurons were obtained from individuals with a diagnosis of an inherited form of motor neuron disease (IGHMBP2 related disease).
